cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've secured the charity's donation with a loan. I'll run the auction and clear it as soon as the bids come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll keep catering tiny. You can approve every expense; I'll make sure none of the donation is wasted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum isn't bidding. She's only coming to drive us home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid for the lots ourselves and resell them later. You set the maximum; I'll raise my paddle only when you nod. Protecting that donation is the responsible thing now.
